ValidationRule.description: Ensure the value of either the parent or child bundle level field is None or 1.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (TEXT(AscendingNestedLevel__c) != null && TEXT(AscendingNestedLevel__c) != '1') || (TEXT(DescendingNestedLevel__c) != null && TEXT(DescendingNestedLevel__c) != '1') || (TEXT(DescendingActionNesting__c) != null && TEXT(DescendingActionNesting__c) != '1')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The maximum supported Bundle Level is 1.
